deficiencies.description: The source text leaves the singular pronoun 'it' ambiguous between 'invasion' and 'malignancy' ('So invasion and malignancy are really, really important diagnostically. So it's defined as...'). The rewrite resolves this unclear statement by choosing one specific reading, stating that malignancy is defined as the ability to invade surrounding tissue.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So invasion and malignancy are really, really important diagnostically. So it's defined as the ability to invade the surrounding tissue.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Invasion and malignancy are very important diagnostically, and malignancy is defined as the ability to invade the surrounding tissue.
